Site.tagline: A free, plain-language health check for your website

Metadata.title: {name}: free website health check
Metadata.description: Check your homepage for speed, search visibility, accessibility and technical problems. Get a clear report in plain language, with what to fix first.
Metadata.guidesDescription: Plain-language guides to fix common website problems: showing up in search, speed on phones, accessibility and security. With steps for WordPress, Wix and Shopify.

HomePage.title: Is your website helping or hurting your business?
HomePage.intro: Enter your homepage address and get a clear report: what is wrong, why it matters, and what to fix first.
HomePage.scope: We check one page (your homepage) plus your robots.txt and sitemap files.
HomePage.trust: Free, no sign-up. Automated checks, not a full audit.

performance.title: Speed on phones
performance.body: Google tests how fast your homepage loads on a phone, the way most of your visitors see it.

seo.title: Showing up in search
seo.body: Your page title, the summary shown in Google, headings, and whether search engines are allowed to list your page.

accessibility.title: Easy for everyone to use
accessibility.body: Automated checks for image descriptions, labelled form fields and buttons, so more people can use your site.

technical.title: Technical health
technical.body: A secure connection, error pages, redirects, basic protections, your site icon, and the files that guide search engines.

local.title: Local business details
local.body: If you serve local customers: your address, a phone number people can tap, opening hours and a map.

how.step1: Enter your homepage address. No sign-up, no payment.
how.step2: We run Google's speed test on a phone and our own checks of your page. It takes about a minute.
how.step3: You get a plain-language report: what to fix first, why it matters, and steps for your platform.

HomePage.who: Small business owners who want to know if their website is costing them customers, without learning technical words. If you work with a developer or an agency, one button turns your report into a to-do list for them.

free.a: Yes. Checking your website is free and there is nothing to buy.

signup.a: No. Enter your address and get your report. There are no accounts and no sign-up.

what.a: One page, your homepage, plus your robots.txt and sitemap files. We look at speed on phones, showing up in search, ease of use and technical health.

full.q: Is this a full audit of my website?
full.a: No. These are automated checks of one page. They find common problems quickly, but they can't replace a review by a person or test every page.

kept.q: How long is my report kept?
kept.a: Reports are kept for 30 days so you can share the link, then deleted automatically.

rescan.q: How do I know if my fixes worked?
rescan.a: Open your report and choose "Re-scan my site". We check again and show what was fixed and how your score changed.

AuditForm.localHint: Adds checks for your address, phone number, opening hours and map.

stages.page: Checking search, accessibility and technical basics

Report.title: Website report for {host}
Report.scope: We checked one page (the homepage) plus its robots.txt and sitemap files. These are automated checks, not a full audit.
Report.exampleNotice: This is an example report for a made-up bakery website. Check your own site to get yours.

gradeSummary.A: Your website is in great shape.
gradeSummary.B: Your website is in good shape, with a few things to improve.
gradeSummary.C: Your website works, but some problems are costing you visitors.
gradeSummary.D: Your website has problems that are likely costing you customers.
gradeSummary.F: Your website has serious problems. Start with the list below.

Report.expires: This report link works until {date}. After that, the report is deleted.

actions.copyFailed: Couldn't copy. Copy the address from your browser bar instead.
actions.technicalViewHint: Show developer details for every issue

banners.psiFailed: Google's speed test didn't answer this time, so speed is missing from your score. The other checks are complete. Try again in a little while.
banners.htmlFailed: Search, accessibility and technical checks are missing. The speed results come from Google's test.
banners.jsShell: Your page seems to build its content in the visitor's browser. We read the page as it is first sent, so we may have missed some of its content.
banners.blockedTitle: Your website turned our visit away
banners.blocked: Your website answered with an error (code {status}). It may block automated tools like ours. The results are based on the page we were shown.
banners.platform: This looks like a {platform} site, so we added {platform} steps where we have them.

vitals.title: Speed on phones, in plain words
vitals.source: Measured by Google on a simulated phone. Real visits can be faster or slower.

fixFirst.title: Fix these first
fixFirst.intro: The biggest wins for the least effort.
fixFirst.none: Nothing to fix right now. Nice work!

rescan.hint: Fixed something? Check again to see your progress.

compare.title: Since your last check
compare.dropped: Your score went down from {before} to {after}.
compare.fixedIntro: Nice work! These problems are gone.
compare.noneFixed: Nothing has been fixed since last time yet.
compare.stillOpenIntro: These are still open. You'll find the steps in the list below.

developer.title: Send to my developer
developer.intro: Copy a ready-made to-do list with the technical details your developer or agency needs.
developer.copyFailed: Couldn't copy. Select the text below and copy it yourself.

DeveloperMessage.heading: Website fixes for {url}
DeveloperMessage.checkedOn: Checked on {date} with {tool}: automated checks of one page, not a full audit.

ReportNotFound.title: This report isn't available
ReportNotFound.body: The link may be wrong, or the report has expired. Reports are kept for {days} days.

ReportError.title: We couldn't load this report
ReportError.body: Something went wrong on our side. Please try again in a moment.

Errors.INVALID_URL: That doesn't look like a website address. Try something like example.com.
Errors.BLOCKED: We can't check this address. Only public websites can be checked.
Errors.TIMEOUT: The website took too long to answer. Please try again in a moment.
Errors.NOT_HTML: This address doesn't lead to a web page. Enter the address of your homepage.
Errors.TOO_LARGE: This page is too big for us to check.
Errors.UNREACHABLE: We couldn't reach this website. Check the address and make sure the site is online.
Errors.TOO_MANY_REDIRECTS: This address sends visitors through too many other addresses. Check that it leads to your homepage.
Errors.RATE_LIMITED: You have run a lot of checks in the last hour. Please try again in {minutes} min.
Errors.SERVER_ERROR: Something went wrong on our side. Please try again in a moment.

Nav.footerNote: Automated checks of one page, not a full audit.
